title: Jewelry is at the bottom of the muddy sea.

text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl vs. Taiki Shuttle. The Debut Selection race, where outstanding talents clash under the rain, has finally begun!

text_block_list.name: Seaking Zapar
text_block_list.text: Let us make this the greatest race ever, Taiki! Come now, keep up with me!

text_block_list.name: Seaking Zapar
text_block_list.text: Oh? My legs... What is this sluggish, slippery sensation?

text_block_list.name: Seaking Zapar
text_block_list.text: Ah, goodness, I can't push through! What dreadful dullness!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Go right ahead! Pardon me, coming through!

text_block_list.name: Seaking Zapar
text_block_list.text: Aaaah, Taiki?!
Seeking the Pearl fell back in the blink of an eye. Far from keeping up with Taiki Shuttle, she ended up falling behind the other Umamusume as well.

text_block_list.name: Seaking Zapar
text_block_list.text: Unbelievable! How could this... How could I suffer such a one-sided defeat?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Pearl, great job out there today! Could it be that you're just not great at handling bad track conditions?

text_block_list.name: Seaking Zapar
text_block_list.text: Pathetic... Hehe, you may be right. I certainly dislike this terrain. But that is not the real issue here.

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: There is a far greater reason as to why I couldn't deliver a good run.

text_block_list.name: タイキシャトル
text_block_list.text: Oh... and what might that reason be?

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: It is simply that 'my mood wasn't in it'! It was a matter of the heart, rather than physical condition!

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: Ho-ho-ho-ho! It seems my passion gave a firm 'no thank you' to this muddy track!

text_block_list.name: 新人トレーナーA
text_block_list.text: H-Hold on a second... Seeking the Pearl is laughing out loud even after such a crushing loss...

text_block_list.name: 中堅トレーナーA
text_block_list.text: Yeah, so it wasn't just poor handling of bad ground, but an issue of temperament. If that's the case... she's going to be tricky to train.
choice_data_list: やっかいって、どの辺が？

text_block_list.name: 中堅トレーナーA
text_block_list.text: That means her underperformance isn't limited to just bad tracks. Whenever there's any negative factor, she fails to demonstrate her true ability. In other words―

text_block_list.name: 中堅トレーナーA
text_block_list.text: She's got temperament issues. Judging from how she's acting right now, she seems pretty moody and temperamental...
―Temperament issues. Even if she possesses extraordinary talent, whether she unleashes it or not depends entirely on her mood.
And if that could be triggered not just by bad tracks, but by any minor external factor―

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: Now then, it's scouting time! Thank you for waiting, everyone! At long last, I am ready to receive your bouquets!

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: Come rush to my side with your grandest dreams! Come on! Hey, come on now!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: トレーナーたち
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOO, TAIKI SHUTTLE~~~!!

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: Wait, hold on... What?!
A flood of scouting offers rushed entirely toward Taiki Shuttle. Not a single person stepped into Seeking the Pearl's wide-open arms.
―That night. Walking through the academy grounds, I found myself deep in thought. For an Umamusume with such immense pre-debut hype to receive zero offers was exceedingly rare.
'Temperament issues,' meaning 'fickle and moody.' If she truly is an impossibly selfish Umamusume, it's only natural people would hesitate to scout her...
Just then, I happened to spot Seeking the Pearl standing all alone. What could she be doing?

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed. Today, my spirit truly failed to ignite. My aversion to the mud overpowered my competitive drive...

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: Losing traction to the point where even the will to challenge slips away... It must have felt like that. And then―

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: What about the distance? 1600m... I am not unsuited for it. However, whether a distance is my forte or not isn't decided by me alone.

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: The world is vast. Even if I excel at it, there are Umamusume who excel at it even more. Just like Taiki...

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: The brilliance of the gem that is myself... cannot be defined by me alone. Surrounded by countless extraordinary talents, how do I carve out my own path?

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: If I cannot reach the pinnacle right now, then I must find another route. Or perhaps―
That profile of hers was completely unimaginable from her daytime persona. The face of someone diving deep into the essence of things... calculating and contemplating.
It was a profoundly thoughtful expression, impossible to imagine on an Umamusume who hadn't even debuted yet. Like a goddess of wisdom―
'Temperament issues.' A sudden doubt arose in my mind. Could an Umamusume truly incapable of controlling a wild, unruly temper...
Truly make an expression like that?
